title: HE'S SETTING ME FREE

lines.text: He's setting me free, this Holy Ghost power,
He's setting me free, this very hour,
He's flooding my soul, He's making me whole,
He's setting me free, free, free,

chords:
[Verse]
He's [G]setting me free, this Holy Ghost power,
He's [D]setting me free, this very hour,
He's [G]flooding my soul, He's [C]making me whole,
He's [G]setting me free, free, [D]free,
This [G]Holy Ghost power.
lyrics:
[Verse]
He's setting me free, this Holy Ghost power,
He's setting me free, this very hour,
He's flooding my soul, He's making me whole,
He's setting me free, free, free,
This Holy Ghost power.
